# colivingDB

> A free, curated directory of 612 colivings worldwide, plus 22 nomad festivals and 13 community chapters — one map, native-currency pricing, no login and no email wall. Covers permanent colivings, dated pop-up editions and nomad festivals across 85 countries. Last updated October 15, 2026.

colivingDB is built and maintained by Caroline Lupini, a full-time digital nomad since 2014 who has lived and worked across more than a hundred countries. Listings are nomad-style colivings (shared living plus community, usually with coworking), plus a small number of nomad festivals and community chapters, each tagged as such; those without accommodation say so. Student housing and urban rent-by-the-room operators are left out. Every listing links to the operator's own site. Dead links are audited and removed.

Key facts:
- 612 colivings, 22 nomad festivals and 13 community chapters (no accommodation), 85 countries
- 112 dated editions (traveling programs, cruises, camps, and nomad festivals)
- Prices from €46 to €6,892 per month
- Filters: country, city, room type, minimum stay, price, pop-up month, currency

## Notes
- Every page has a markdown twin: append `index.md` to any page URL.
- Prices are the lowest listed monthly rate, in the operator's own currency, converted to EUR for comparison.
- Sitemap: https://colivingdb.com/sitemap.xml
